title: 휴가 계획: 예약하고, 짐 싸고, 출발해요
objective: By the end, you can use ten vacation-planning words, such as 휴가, 예약하다, 출발하다, 도착하다 and 짐, in short sentences about your own trip.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for planning a vacation, from taking time off and booking a room to packing, leaving and arriving.

task.title: Use the vacation words
task.line: Use the word list on page 1 to choose, write or put in order the right words.

words.example: 다음 주에 일주일 동안 휴가를 내요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm taking a week off next week.
I made vacation plans with a friend over the weekend.
I booked the hotel in advance last month.

words.meaning: to leave, to depart (start a trip)
words.exampleMeaning: The train leaves Seoul Station at 8 a.m.
I'll call you when I get to Busan.

words.meaning: luggage, bags you carry on a trip
words.exampleMeaning: I had a lot of luggage, so I took a taxi.

words.example: 저는 보통 여행 가기 전날 밤에 짐을 싸요.
words.exampleMeaning: I usually pack the night before a trip.

words.example: 여권을 집에 두고 와서 다시 갔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I left my passport at home, so I went back for it.

words.meaning: a place to stay (hotel, guesthouse, etc.)
words.example: 이번 숙소는 바다 바로 앞에 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The place we're staying this time is right in front of the sea.
Something came up, so I cancelled my hotel booking.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 서울에서 10시에 출발해서 부산에 1시에 (출발했어요 / 도착했어요). ② 밤늦게 도착해서 잘 곳이 필요해요. 오늘 (숙소를 / 여권을) 예약할 거예요. ③ 아이가 아파서 여행을 못 가요. 기차표를 (취소할 / 출발할) 거예요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the word list: ____이 너무 무거워요. 좀 들어 주세요.
Write the Korean word from the list for each meaning: ① the document you show at the airport to travel to another country ② days off from work to rest or travel
Put the steps of a trip in order: ㄱ. 공항에서 비행기가 출발해요. ㄴ. 인터넷으로 비행기 표를 예약해요. ㄷ. 제주도에 도착해요. ㄹ. 표를 예약한 뒤 전날 밤에 집에서 짐을 싸요.
Answer in Korean with one or two sentences. Use 출발하다 and 예약하다. Say where you will go and when you will leave: 이번 휴가에 어디로 언제 출발해요?
answers: ① 도착했어요 ② 숙소를 ③ 취소할
Sample answer: 다음 달 3일에 부산으로 출발해요. 바다 앞 숙소를 예약했어요. (Any answer that uses 출발하다 and 예약하다 with a place and a time is correct.)
